text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...What... What an incredible run—!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...If it's her, surely even the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...? Did you just say... if it were her—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Representative Exchange Race came to 
an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, called to order by Mei Satake, 
the project participants lined up in the 
gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among them was Chrono Genesis, her gaze 
burning with a declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I will read out the names of the Umamusume 
selected as representatives. The first is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing our joy with <chrname>, we waited for the 
next name to be called—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm sorry to interrupt the 
announcement. ...Please let me withdraw as 
the representative.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Hmm... May I ask the reason?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I'd like to support the racers 
who will be running.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I-I pride myself on knowing more about 
races than most.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
She even has her own proprietary 
technique, the "Genesis Method," which 
constructs race predictions based on 
massive amounts of data.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If we can grasp victory together with 
these, nothing would bring me greater joy.
choice_data_list:
Even after yearning for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe that much?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Last night, I factored in the data from 
the Representative Exchange Race and made 
a rough prediction for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe. That was when my intuition 
struck.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't enough. Rather, if we applied 
this method to the other members, the path 
to winning Japan's first Umamusume victory 
would surely open up... or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Those are all my reasons for withdrawing. 
Moving forward, please allow me to 
contribute as a supporter."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. I understand your feelings 
completely."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Chrono Genesis stepped down from 
being a representative and decided to 
contribute as a support member instead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, when I recall that passionate 
look in her eyes... Could someone like 
that really give up so easily?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. G-Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was thinking that, I happened to 
bump into her by chance.
choice_data_list:
...Was it really the right call to 
withdraw?
...Are you sure it was okay to withdraw?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please let me switch to a support 
role from now on.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...To be precise, to support <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...To tell you the truth... right now, I 
feel an unusual racing in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Back then—ever since I raced against her 
in the Representative Exchange Race and 
saw her back pulling away.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If it is her, I am certain she can conquer 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Especially—now, this year. What's more, if 
we could provide further support through 
the Genesis Method...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: “<chrname>” can win...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The first Japanese Umamusume to conquer 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe— we are 
about to witness a historic moment.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I just... cannot resist that urge no 
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
So, without fail. Let us go seize it. And 
show me your victory at the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...This, and this. If I give them these 
materials as well, I'm sure they'll find 
them useful..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I need to pull myself together—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Project L'Arc isn't a permanent event. If 
we miss this chance, conquering the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe might remain out of 
reach forever."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, she currently has the 
highest probability of winning, so—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Th-that's... why...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, ugh...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ugh, uuu... ugh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Carrying the fiery passion left behind by 
Chrono Genesis, I want to charge ahead 
toward conquering the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.
